operations.why: Two corners, T1 and T2. Detection merged them because their 31 m gap falls just under the 30 m merge rule — a boundary case that flips between laps, so it is pinned here rather than left to chance.

Detected 5 is not a corner: a 0.153 rad left flick under braking (throttle 0, brake 0.5-0.7) as the car positions for the 1.03 rad right that follows. It is T6's entry. Note this merges ACROSS a sign change, which is the opposite of what the split below does.
One corner, T8. Detected 8 is the entry arc onto the banking that detected 9 sustains.

T9 and T10. Detection averaged the steering across this region and reported 'right', hiding a 0.471 rad sustained left at 0.6675 that precedes the 0.677 rad right at 0.6885. Splitting at the sign change recovers both. Detected 11 is T11, so this is a left-right-left.
One corner, T12. Detected 12 is the entry to the banking that detected 13 sustains — same shape as the T8 case.
